title: How long is A.J. Brown out? Injury update, return date for Patriots WR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How long is A.J. Brown out? Injury update, return date for Patriots WR
sources.description: A.J. Brown suffered an ankle injury in the Patriots' Week 1 loss to the Seahawks. Patriots coach Mike Vrabel gave a short update on the wide receiver.
